mainEntity.name: How much does a Range Rover Evoque D165 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full rebuilt or reconditioned engine replacement for a Range Rover Evoque D165 typically ranges from £4,800 to £7,000 for supply only, depending on the specialist and the extent of upgrades included. Used engines start around £2,000 but carry higher risk, while rebuilt units include upgraded components and a 12-month warranty.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of a failing AJ20D4 engine in a Range Rover Evoque D165?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common early warning signs in the Range Rover Evoque D165 are a rising oil level on the dipstick, a distinct rattling noise from the front of the engine on cold starts (timing chain rattle), or illuminated DPF and temperature warning lights. You should also watch for a strong diesel smell from the oil filler cap.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Range Rover Evoque D165?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A typical Range Rover Evoque D165 holds a UK market value of £15,000-£25,000, making a £4,800-£7,000 rebuilt engine a financially sound investment that preserves the vehicle's performance, refinement, and strong resale value for years to come.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Range Rover Evoque D165 engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional supply and fit service for a Range Rover Evoque D165 typically takes 2 to 4 days, depending on the specialist's workload and whether any ancillary components like the DPF or cooling system are being upgraded simultaneously. Sourcing a quality rebuilt unit may add a few days.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between the Range Rover Evoque D165 and the D200 engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Range Rover Evoque D165 uses a 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-4 mild-hybrid diesel engine (AJ20D4) producing 163 hp, prioritising fuel efficiency and lower emissions. In contrast, the D200 uses a higher-output calibration of the same architecture (or a twin-turbo setup in earlier models) producing 201 hp, offering greater torque and performance for heavier loads or spirited driving.

commonProblems.h2: Range Rover Evoque D165 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The 2.0-litre Ingenium mild-hybrid diesel (AJ20D4) in the Range Rover Evoque D165 is generally more refined than earlier iterations, but DPF-related oil dilution and timing chain wear remain the dominant replacement drivers. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Oil Dilution & DPF Regeneration Failure - Why the Range Rover Evoque D165 AJ20D4 Loses Lubrication
problems.rootCause: Frequent short journeys prevent the DPF from completing active regeneration cycles. Unburned diesel fuel passes into the sump during regeneration attempts, raising oil levels, thinning viscosity, and destroying the oil’s ability to protect bearings and timing components.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Full oil and filter change (two flushes), forced DPF regeneration, PCM software update to modify regen strategy.
repairOptions.longevity: Temporary fix if underlying driving pattern doesn't change. May last 10-20k miles before recurrence.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit rebuilt unit with revised DPF calibration, upgraded oil pump, injector coding, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: Recommended if engine has run with heavily diluted oil for extended period or has seized.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Range Rover Evoque D165 of relevant age (2019-present) currently holds a UK market value of approximately £15,000-£25,000 [THIRD-PARTY - Auto Trader market observations]. At this premium value band, a reconditioned or rebuilt engine replacement is a small fraction of the vehicle's worth and easily justifies the investment to preserve performance and resale value.
problems.recommendation: Oil dilution is a known calibration flaw in early Ingenium diesels. If your oil level warning appears or the dipstick shows a rising level, act immediately: a specialist oil flush and software update (£250-£400) can prevent catastrophic damage. However, if your Evoque has already suffered bottom-end knocking or seized, do not attempt a repair - fit a rebuilt unit with the latest engine management calibration.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt AJ20D4 Range Rover Evoque D165 engine prices

problems.h4: Timing Chain Tensioner Wear - Why the Range Rover Evoque D165 AJ20D4 Develops a Rattle
problems.affectedModels: Range Rover Evoque D165 (AJ20D4 / 204DTD, 2019-present, especially pre-November 2019 builds)
problems.rootCause: Oil dilution accelerates timing chain tensioner wear. The tensioner relies on oil pressure; degraded oil causes tensioner failure, leading to chain slack, guide breakage, and eventual chain jump or seizure.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace timing chain kit (chain, tensioner, guides, cam sprockets), oil pump, and perform full oil system flush.
repairOptions.longevity: Only viable if caught before chain jump. Adds 60k+ miles if upgraded parts are used.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit rebuilt unit with upgraded timing chain components, new oil pump, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: Best value for high-mileage engines or those that have already jumped timing. Addresses all failure points permanently.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: As above, the £15,000-£25,000 value of a Range Rover Evoque D165 makes targeted repairs like a timing chain refresh highly viable. A full engine replacement is rarely justified for chain rattle alone unless secondary damage has occurred.
problems.recommendation: Do not ignore a cold-start rattle in your Range Rover Evoque D165. A timely chain and tensioner replacement by a specialist is a well-documented fix that preserves the engine's longevity at a fraction of the cost of a full rebuild.
